about: The MW2 live check (desk control surface spec, Plan of Work, MW2): doperpowers desk-ctl-mw2, sminos 1.12.0, Claude Code 2.1.310, an isolated profile behind a recording stub (zero inference; the stub answers the side question with a canned reply and usage). `capabilities` is the bridge's GET /status; `btw` its /command answers to a side question asked before the first model request (refused) and when idle (started), and the btw events of the latter as the child relays them (the rpc nonce the child added).

decide.scope.reason: not in sminos 1.12.0: a later version of the plugin adds it

decide.interrupt.reason: a decision is answered once it is queued, so a deny cannot report what stopping the turn left running: deny, then Interrupt

forget.reason: after --resume the engine brings back what a cut left out (2.1.310): it needs an engine fix or a supported cut

rewind-files.reason: the mod API has no file rollback: /rewind in the terminal

elicitation.answer.reason: a mod's answer carries no action or content, so it cannot answer an MCP server's form: answer it in the terminal

refused.error: nothing to fork yet: the session has made no model request since it started or was cleared
